column1: # Rows db.xc.* (line RG item X-chunk, 2026-11-25): BLASTN query-chunk stops and step order (CHUNK_SIZE / OVERLAP_CHUNK_SIZE) over tests/db_search/taxfilter/tfn (and tfn.fna for -subject), aliaskeys/e_nF, aliaskeys/e_nA, aliaskeys/n_nseq0, dbcounts/avg2p32, and arch_tbn_snucl_nonsq, with queries in tests/fasta/xchunk/ (slices of HBA1 from tfn.fna): empty chunks (evened < overlap at 140/100 L=90, exact overlap at 150/100 L=100, negative wrapped size at -100/-200 L=310, unwrapped negative at -132/-200 L=201) stop in CQuerySplitter::Split before chunk masking, chunk setup, database reads, and empty-DB completion, after earlier batches' reports and prologs; negative-pair gaps (-100/-200 L=248) refuse at the first valid chunk with subjects in hand after setup checks and sequence-file reads; gapvalid (valid letters only in the gap) reaches traceback setup (Traceback failed on avg2p32, Database memory map file error on e_nF, exit 0 on normal/nonsq); non-split controls (-ungapped, all-N) run normally; duplicate-id split batches meet chunk setup and read errors. Freeze alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --ncbi-bin DIR --program blastn --only db.xc.
